annotations.title: Preview CI cost fixes for every app

description: Preview 'Apply to every app' for the CI cost fixes (ADR 0047 amendment): every CI advice item that carries an autofix, across the apps this key may change (viewers' apps are left out), grouped per app and repo, so each repo can get ONE draft pull request (one CI run) for all its fixes. Per repo { projectId, projectName, repo, items [{ key, workflowPath, kind (add_concurrency | skip_drafts | weekly_cron | ignore_docs_paths), title, evidence, monthSavingUsd (estimated USD per 30 days, null when Mushi cannot price it), state (ready | pr_open | in_progress), prUrl }], readyItems, monthSavingUsd (the ready items' priced saving), unpricedItems, block (set when Mushi already knows the repo's GitHub access cannot edit workflow files: GITHUB_WORKFLOWS_WRITE_MISSING, from the setup check or the last attempt) }, largest saving first, plus totals, caps { reposPerRequest: 10, itemsPerRepo: 20 } and partial (set when part of the advice could not be read). Optional projectId limits it to one app; an account-level key with none reads every app. Read-only: it changes nothing. Open them with apply_ci_cost_fix_rollout.

projectId.description: Limit it to one app; omitted with an account-level key, every app you may change (`project_id` is accepted too.)
